experiment: T1 temporal misalignment (stale image + current alignment)
platform: AutoDL instance, RTX 3090, PyTorch 2.1.0 / CUDA 12.1 / Python 3.10 (conda env bevfusion)
dataset: nuScenes v1.0-trainval, val split, 6019 keyframe samples

definition.substitution: 6 camera images replaced by real historical frames k steps back along sample_data.prev; calibration, poses, LiDAR and GT of the current sample kept unchanged
definition.note: eligible sets for k=1 and k=2 are identical (scene-first frames have no predecessor)

conclusions: Temporal misalignment monotonically degrades fusion (mAP 0.6855 -> 0.6810 -> 0.6699; mATE rises 0.2786 -> 0.2828 -> 0.2881).
No backfire within k<=2: fusion_k2 mAP 0.6699 remains +2.2pt above lidar-only on the same subset (0.6479).
Degradation concentrates in positional metrics (mATE/mAOE); mASE/mAVE/mAAE nearly unchanged.
Larger k (e.g. 3/5/10) needed to test whether backfire threshold exists.
